newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers higher on firm cargo prices.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers higher on firm cargo prices.

text.p: Singapore bunkers were quoted higher on the back of firm fuel oil prices from local buyers, traders said on Tuesday.
Although there has been no significant fundamental change, "suppliers are cautiously holding back, waiting for further cargo gains," said one independent.
Fuel oil 180-cst grade swaps soared on late Tuesday with March at $100.75/101.75 per tonne and April at $96.50/100.75.
Bunker 380-cst was quoted at $98-$100 per tonne and 180-cst at $105-$107. MDO and gas oil were quoted at $190-$195 and $205-$210 respectively. -- Singapore Newsroom (+65-870 3571)
